judged_text: addMembers leaves the 'TODO: should clear the input' unresolved, so the user-selector retains the just-added usernames. After clicking Add, the usernames remain in the input; clicking Add again re-submits the same list (harmlessly re-adding duplicates but confusingly showing a stale pending set), and the admin must manually clear the field each time.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the `addMembers` action includes a comment `// TODO: should clear the input` and does not clear `this.get("usernames")` after calling `this.get("model").addMembers(...)`. In the template, `{{user-selector usernames=usernames ...}}` binds the input to that same `usernames` property, so the entered usernames will remain displayed after clicking Add. This is a real, diff-grounded UX/workflow issue (stale input / easy to re-submit the same list), but it’s not a correctness defect that breaks functionality in the diff itself.
